topic: Patrícia's whereabouts on Sunday and her relationship with the victim

statements.text: My relationship with Mr. Figueiredo was entirely professional. We had disagreements, as colleagues do. That is normal in a results-driven organisation.
statements.press_response: There was a procedural matter under review. I was managing it through the appropriate internal channels. I don't think it's relevant.

statements.text: On Sunday I was at home all day. I ordered dinner at half past seven and spent the evening reviewing some documents. I had no reason to go into the office.
statements.press_response: I have a delivery confirmation on my phone. I'm happy to provide it.

statements.text: I learned about Mr. Figueiredo's passing Monday morning, like everyone else. It was a shock. Regardless of professional differences, no one wants to hear that.
statements.press_response: I don't think my emotional response to a colleague's death is relevant to these proceedings.

statements.text: I have never purchased or consumed energy drinks. I don't see how a product found on Mr. Figueiredo's desk has anything to do with me.
statements.press_response: I really must object to this line of questioning. The insinuation is frankly offensive.
